snippet.title: Treasure 'n Trio: Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The humorous fantasy Sokoban-based puzzle game Treasure 'n Trio will be released on October 9, 2025.
Control three unique characters to collect all sorts of treasures.

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214530/Treasure_n_Trio/
X: https://x.com/TreasureNTrio

#indiegame #puzzlegame
